text:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to lock sequencing for the prefetched-quant initiative. Customer (PilotCorp) expects private pilot gating next month. Product needs launch criteria & owner by EOW.
Maria: PilotCorp wants private model with KMS + HSM, and predictable latency under 200ms p50 for main prompt set. They also want a 2-week acceptance window.
Sunil: Runtime note: quant kernels for that model are still in final QA. If we push private pilot in 3 weeks we risk kernel regressions. Current perf (canary): p50 ~ 210ms, p95 ~ 680ms on A100-80.
Tanya: Infra needs 3 things: explicit KMS key ARN, onprem HSM slot allocation, and prewarm plan for reserved GPUs. Also need security review signoff for HSM bits.
Alex: Can we short-circuit — host pilot in Dedicated (no HSM) and add HSM later? That buys time. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sunil: Feasible. We can run Dedicated with customer-cipher fallback (no HSM) and a documented KMS-only mode. Latency should be fine if we reserve prewarm slots. Fallback plan: quantized variant (4-bit) if final kernels flake.
Maria: PilotCorp insisted on HSM for compliance but might accept KMS-only for initial acceptance if we document roadmap. I'll confirm with PO.
Tanya: If we go KMS-only initially, infra still needs a reservation: 6 reserved GPUs in us-west-2 for 2 weeks, prewarmed. I can provision but need a ticket + budget approval.
Sunil: Prewarm command we use for staging (copy-paste):
```
# prewarm reserved pool
redwoodctl prewarm --pool pref-quant --min 6 --region us-west-2 --model rdx/quant-v2
```
Sunil: Note: also set cache-ttl=30s for eval runs to avoid hot-cache skew.
Tanya: Security: Filing SVC-9876 for HSM review. Need security owner and estimated time. @Alex who owns security liasion?
Alex: I'll own security liaison for this pilot. Add me to SVC-9876.
Maria: Owners and deadlines proposal: Product owner Maria (acceptance criteria by Fri), Runtime owner Sunil (kernel signoff or fallback plan by Tue), Infra owner Tanya (GPU reservation & ticket by Wed), Security owner Alex (HSM review kickoff by Wed). Does that work?
Sunil: Works. If kernels aren't green by Tue we switch to quant-v2 fallback and run perf smoke. I'll post perf snapshot in #eng-runtime then.
Tanya: I'll provision provisional GPUs and hold billing until we get PO confirmation. Will update ticket with cost delta.
deploy-bot: CI check: model-quant-tests failing on canary (2/23 tests) — @Sunil please review: https://ci.redwood/v/8721
Sunil: Saw the CI alerts, investigating root cause now. Likely a padding edge-case with attention cache. If needed we can ship with quant-v1 as second fallback.
Maria: I'll confirm with PilotCorp on KMS-only acceptance and get back by EOD. If they accept, we proceed with the owners timeline above.
Alex: Good — plan of record: aim for Dedicated KMS-only pilot next month; HSM follow-on. Owners: Maria, Sunil, Tanya, Alex. Next check-in Wed 10am PT to confirm tickets and kernel status. :white_check_mark:
